title: First 100 in-Store Customers Get a Free Large Pepperoni Pizza @ Pizza Hut (Participating Restaurants Only)
body:
Deal: First 100 in-Store Customers Get a Free Large Pepperoni Pizza @ Pizza Hut (Participating Restaurants Only)

[Nvu] If it was first 100 per store thatd be sick,
[Nvu] (profanity) if so, best to fill up the car with others then LOL
[scalebearer] Oh dear… those poor workers are not going to have a good day next Saturday.
Unless there's a one time wage boost that Pizza Hut will give them, but they're probably going to keep paying them the bare minimum.
[Dealr] I believe these things normally work with them putting an extra person on (you would hope at the bare minimum). No wage boost.
[Fuzor] Total of 2 participating stores for the whole state of Tas lol. Thats just sad
[danzha] I wonder if the first 100 per store is based on time of pick up or order, if the latter surely it'll just get snapped up by people ordering as soon as the clock ticks over to midnight.
The fine print didn't clarify this, but I did find a mention of "Free merchandise available while stocks last" which is interesting.
[AsukaST] It says in store only at the very top of the page so its base on the time you order in store. Excludes online order.
[PeppaPigDidNthngWrng] It says "Available in-store and pick-up only at participating Pizza Hut stores"
[AsukaST] ya, "in-store and pick-up only" is the same as "in-store only" + more detail
it's not in-store or online pick up, it's "in-store + pick up"
which excludes in-store pre order for delivery, online pick up order and online delivery order.
i.e. "A and 1 only" excludes A and 2, B and 1, B and 2.
[hibijibis] what time does pizza hut usually open? breakfast pepperoni pizza?!
[timhn] None near me but I'll watch this deal with some popcorn on Sat
[shortgum] I prefer pizzahut bring back the decent cashback via shopback or topcashback deals over handing out pan pepperoni pizza.
[PeppaPigDidNthngWrng] Available in-store and pick-up only at participating Pizza Hut stores.
So you can order online, just doesn't include delivery.
ALSO: "Free merchandise available while stocks last."
Did someone say free?
[jimbler] My local store opens at 11:00 am, but knowing the owners, they'll be telling people they are already sold out by 11:01.
